text_block_list.text:
After our outing, Marvelous Sunday said 
there was a place she wanted to go, so I 
followed along—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Over there! Look at that signboard!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yup! I promised Ricky! You come with us 
too, Trainer☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, everyone! Mix in the water 
and knead the dough thoroughly in the 
bowl~!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Yes!
choice_data_list: What kind of bread are you making?
What kind of bread are you going to make?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous good-fortune bread☆★☆ I'm making 
it together with Rickey★☆★

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And your job is to eat it☆ Just sit right 
there and watch!

A bit bewildered that the reason they 
invited me here was 'as a taste tester'... 
I decided to watch over them as they baked 
their bread.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Once we're done kneading the dough, it's 
fermentation time~♪ 40 minutes in the 
oven's proofing mode~."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And~ next is picking the ingredients! 
There are tons ready over there, so let's 
choose a special combo♪

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I want to include both Marvelous Flavor 
and Good Luck Flavor! What kind should we 
make, I wonder~~??

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Maybe we should get creative with the 
shape? What do you think, Akebono-sensei~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, two-tone bread sounds great~. 
Connect a Marvelous flavor bread and a 
Good Luck flavor bread, and—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing☆★ That way they get to enjoy two 
different flavors☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I know! Let's keep our choice of 
ingredients a secret from each otherâ 
With an extra layer of surprise, it'll be 
simply MARVELOUSâ

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Nice, nice! Let's pick out our absolute 
best ingredients!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
!! These ingredients... might just be 
super Marvelous...☆

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: All finished~☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Flavor and Good Luck Flavor, a 
two-tone snack bread! Bon appétit☆

What was presented to me was a piece of 
bread shaped like a snowman, made of two 
conjoined spheres.

The first one I tasted was a cream bun 
with strawberries and bananas inside. It 
was delicious!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that one's the good fortune flavor! 
Both strawberries and bananas are power 
foods, you know♪

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: So excited... so excited...☆

The moment it enters the mouth, a sweet 
aroma spreads. However, lurking beneath 
that is an indescribable saltiness and 
bitterness—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Is it tasty??

It tastes terrible, horrifyingly 
terrible...!! However, seeing as they went 
through the trouble of making it for me—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
...? Trainer, you're sweating a ton! What 
does it taste like?! Lemme try a taste—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: !? T-This tastes teeeerribleeee!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Are you two okay? Did you manage to clear 
your palate? Sorry, I was checking on the 
other students for a bit, so I didn't 
catch what happened...—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I'm all right now, thank you, Akebono! 
Though...—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry, Trainer!! I messed up big 
time~~!!
choice_data_list: B-By the way, what did you put in this?
B-By the way, what did you put in this?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Um, chocolate and... salmon, tuna, and 
onions!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Chocolate helps with recovery from 
fatigue, and fish and vegetables are 
packed with nutrition! With this—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I thought it would turn into a marvelous 
surprise bread for Trainer! ...Or so I 
hoped~!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Marvelous-chan has a surprise for 
you: a special treat of freshly baked 
bread☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
After hearing about such a happy plan, how 
could I not want to lend a hand?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let me try again! I really want 
you to feel totally Marvelous from eating 
my bread!
choice_data_list:
With some creativity, it should turn out 
delicious.

text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday had put her whole heart 
into making it just to please me. That 
sentiment made me feel more marvelous than 
anything else ever could...
choice_data_list: So let's make it together next time.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe, I see. Thanks, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Then let's make something super delicious 
together! And become waaaay more 
Marvelous☆★

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's give it one more try then. Do you 
still have time?

Marvelous Sunday's idea is certainly full 
of wonder and excitement. With a little 
ingenuity, it should turn out delicious.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'll definitely make it delicious☆★ 
It might take a while, but please wait for 
it☆
choice_data_list: I'll taste-test as much as you want!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's give it one more try then. Do you 
still have time?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Of cooourse! We've got plenty of time and 
ingredients~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Next time I'll help think up combinations 
too, so let's make something super 
delicious♪"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yay, thank you, Akebono!! Let's all 
discover a marvelous taste togetherââ

And so, with everyone's help—the "Buono, 
Happy, and Marvelous Delicious Bread" was 
complete.
